conversationalSummary.text: TODAY is probably a skip, there just isn’t a reliable window for bodyboarding at Baleal. I’d save the drive—Surfline is reading poor and the wind angle looks badly aligned, so even at Meio da Baia around lunch it may feel too soft without more push. Check Surfline or MEO Beachcam before you leave anyway, and only head out if the cams look surprisingly cleaner than expected.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 80 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 77/100, and wind is the main risk. Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
